title: Equity derivatives: First batch of China onshore active ETFs to unlock thematic alpha

classification.rationale: The note is an equity derivatives trade idea to go long a China/HK dividend stock basket on the back of onshore active ETF launches, which is equity thematic content that fits no rates, FX, macro or central bank category.
classification.runner_up_reason: It references CGB yields and low onshore rates as a driver, but they are supporting context for an equity basket trade, not the main subject.
